map.mRSS 总分 = 17 个解剖部位（面部、双手指、双手掌、双前臂、胸壁、腹壁、: mRSS total = sum of skin thickness scores (0-3 each) at 17 sites (face, both fingers, both palms, both forearms, chest wall, abdominal wall, both thighs, both lower legs, both dorsal feet, both toes); 0 normal, 1 mild, 2 moderate, 3 severe; max 51. ≤5 mild, 6-14 moderate, 15-29 moderate-severe, ≥30 severe.

map.提示：mRSS是SSc皮肤受累的金标准评分，总分0-51。mRSS>15-20提: Note: mRSS is the gold-standard score for SSc skin involvement, total 0-51. mRSS >15-20 suggests diffuse SSc (dcSSc), associated with internal involvement (pulmonary fibrosis/renal crisis). Dynamic mRSS change monitors progression and treatment response; improvement ≥5 points (25%) is clinically meaningful. dcSSc progresses rapidly in early years (first 2-3), then may spontaneously regress. Skin score and internal involvement are not fully parallel; combine with HRCT/PFT/renal function. For clinical reference only.
map.17 区块 0–3：面部2+左手指3+左手掌2+左前臂2+右手指3+右手掌2+右: 17 regions 0-3: face 2 + left fingers 3 + left palm 2 + left forearm 2 + right fingers 3 + right palm 2 + right forearm 2 + chest/abdomen 2 + left thigh 1 + left calf 1 + left foot 1 + right thigh 1 + right calf 1 + right foot 1 = 24, moderate-severe skin involvement.
map.面部1+手指合计4+前臂2+躯干2 = 9，轻度，随访指端溃疡与肺纤维化。: Face 1 + fingers total 4 + forearms 2 + trunk 2 = 9, mild, follow digital ulcers and pulmonary fibrosis.

map.上肢/下肢高提示外周缺血与指端溃疡风险，躯干高提示内脏受累可能。: High upper/lower limb scores suggest peripheral ischemia and digital ulcer risk; high trunk score suggests possible internal involvement.
